17 Nov. Mr. E.'s instructions for tonight, which I am to burn and won't:

Dinner at nine. Ten places, and one more at the foot with a card that says only W.

When they go down he will ring from upstairs — LIBRARY, then DINING, then TURRET. That means clear the table and leave the turret lamp lit till the young lady comes. If she comes, bring her to the library. If anyone else rings, don't answer.

Should anything go wrong, he says the papers are behind the bells, and I know the order.
